值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解 RingConn Gen 3 智慧戒指兩個月實際配戴後的舒適度、功能與續航表現。
  • 掌握心率、血氧、睡眠、運動辨識與震動提醒等功能，評估它是否符合日常健康管理需求。
  • 認識免訂閱 App、充電盒與防水等特色，也能一併了解產品限制與選購考量。

摘要

設計與配戴體驗

作者開箱評測 RingConn Gen 3，介紹其內圓外方造型，以及將感測器移至戒指兩側、平整指腹接觸面的設計，目的在降低異物感，提升長時間配戴的舒適度。戒指採用航太級鈦合金與 PVD 塗層，提供五種顏色及多種尺寸，並附測量套組協助確認戒圍；產品具備 IP68 與 10 ATM 防水規格。

健康監測與運動功能

戒指內建 PPG 光學感測器、三軸加速度計與溫度感測器，可追蹤心率、血氧、HRV、壓力、睡眠及體溫變化。睡眠功能包含入睡與醒來時間分析，也能自動偵測小睡；運動方面則可自動辨識活動，或手動選擇七種運動類別，記錄活動時間、卡路里與心率等資訊。

App 分析與日常提醒

App 首頁整合睡眠、身體狀況、放鬆狀態與活動資訊，並提供生活評分、每週回顧及個人改善計畫，協助使用者追蹤睡眠規律等目標。作者也介紹防曬、脫水風險與疲勞等狀態提示，以及可同步至 Apple 健康與 Google Health Connect 的功能；女性生理追蹤、長輩放大字體模式與親友資料共享，也納入 App 服務之中。

震動提醒與續航表現

RingConn Gen 3 在小巧機身中加入微型震動馬達，可用於久坐、心率過高及生理數據變化提醒，也支援尋找戒指功能。作者表示，在預設偵測與震動功能開啟的情況下，實測續航超過十天；充電盒則可提供長時間的額外電力，官方標示總續航最高可達約 150 天。

buttons in favor of a smart screen design. Let’s start with the appearance; for this ID, Xiaomi opted for a conservative yet more versatile dark-colored body. In. terms of materials, the main structure on all four sides is made of metal. LED to see inside through the door. Design-wise, Xiaomi went with the current mainstream square body, making it perfect for placement on a balcony or inside cabinetry. Because it uses a direct-drive motor, it is overall quieter and more stable. The only thing to note during installation is to ensure the technician levels it properly, and then avoid moving it afterward. Getting back to the most eye-catching part of the exterior, it’s definitely the clean touch panel strip on top. It’s simple to operate; just tap the power button to start, and you’ll see the Mi Home startup animation. From there, you can use the two up and down buttons below the screen to select different cleaning modes. Generally speaking, for regular clothes, you can just select "Smart Wash." The system will automatically detect and plan the cycle. If you want to fine-tune it, you can press "Next" on the right to adjust water temperature, number of rinse cycles, spin speed, and whether to include drying. Once finished, just press "Start" and.

the washing begins. Look at the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro, it starts by spinning empty for a moment when you turn it on. This step isn't a waste of time; it’s weighing the load to calculate the entire wash cycle. I’ll demonstrate here. For example, under identical settings, if I only put in one piece of clothing, the system detects it and finishes in about 30 minutes. But, for instance, if I load a full set of bedding and four pillowcases, you can see that after weighing, it changes to one hour and 16 minutes to complete,. which is the advantage of smart weighing ; the system automatically adjusts the cycle based on the load. For those who can never figure out how to set the washing machine, or for those buying one for elderly family members, having a smart mode is definitely much more convenient. Another major hardware highlight of the Mijia Smart Front Load Washing Machine Pro is the automatic detergent dispensing feature I just mentioned. When we pull out this drawer in the upper left, we can see there are two compartments in total. The one on the left is for detergent. My personal habit is to buy these refill packs and. pour them directly into the dispenser. The design of the refill pack is easier to pour, and it’s usually cheaper, making it perfect for household savings . Also, remember to choose a low-foam detergent suitable for front-load machines. The one on the right has two uses. First, you can add fabric softener . If you don't usually use fabric softener , you don't have to use the second compartment, or you can switch it to disinfectant; just toggle it via the app . If you use disinfectant, remember to check the instructions in the app. Once set, the system automatically determines how much detergent to add and when to dispense it during the weighing process. Oh, and by the way, if you want it more concentrated or less, you can also manually adjust the dispensing ratio in the app. If it runs out, the app will also send you a reminder. Actually, this machine is more than just simple automatic dispensing; what makes this Xiaomi model special is that if we take the machine apart, we can see it has an independent water and detergent mixing module. Inside the module, Xiaomi has added 148 column-shaped channels. So, when it adds detergent, it doesn't just spray it directly onto the clothes ; it fully mixes the detergent internally first to ensure it is highly effective. After mixing, it uses a high-pressure water jet to spray from the channel at the front of the drum. Having covered the exterior, let's move on to the most important hardware aspect of the front-load washer. First, in terms of hardware, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro uses a direct-drive motor, which is more expensive but significantly better. Its main advantages are that it is much more.

durable and offers higher power efficiency. Since it lacks the friction issues of traditional belt-driven systems, it is generally quieter, and direct-drive motors typically allow for more precise rotation control. For example, it enables high-frequency, small-angle back-and-forth rotation, as well as precise stopping. This brings us to the main point: for a 2024 front-load washing machine, getting clothes clean is already a very mature and basic requirement. So, what everyone is competing on now is how to more intelligently control water, temperature. , and the motor. For instance, among models with direct-drive motors, you will see many manufacturers highlighting their ability to perform various types of wash adjustments. Xiaomi, for example , lists their ability to simulate hand-washing with low-friction water flow, dissolve grime with high-penetration water flow, and reduce residue with wave-pattern rinsing; these are all effects achieved by combining smart water control with the motor. Therefore, the current battlefield for front-load washers is no longer just about cleaning; it is about integrating hardware and sensors with finely-tuned. algorithms to achieve delicate hardware control. As a smart home brand, they certainly have an inherent advantage, and all the features mentioned above are essentially built into the various wash modes when you actually use them. Taking Xiaomi as an example, you can unlock over 30 wash modes via the app; you simply choose the corresponding setting, and the system automatically applies the suitable water flow, temperature, and spin parameters. Overall, the direct-drive motor comes at a slightly higher cost, but it provides a relatively stable and much more precise drive solution. Moreover,. hardware tuning for components like off-axis suspensions has matured in recent years, which is ultimately why they dare to offer a 12-year motor warranty. Another interesting point is that everyone knows the mechanism of a drum washer relies on rotation, allowing clothes to drop and create a beating effect, which cleans away dirt through impact, water flow, and detergent. That is why Xiaomi has increased the drum diameter to 525mm this time; beyond providing more rotation space and centrifugal force, it also helps reduce. tangling. Now that we've covered the hardware, let’s move on to the actual testing phase. According to official specifications, the Mijia Smart Front-Load Washing Machine Pro offers a 12.5 kg washing capacity and an 8kg drying capacity. But if you've used a front-loader, you know the kilogram rating isn't very intuitive; it's mainly there so you can compare differences between models. In actual use, because the drum space is limited, a 10 to 12kg model is usually best for a small family of three to four .

The Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro currently offers over 30 washing modes. From my experience, if you're just doing everyday laundry, you can just use the Smart Wash mode, and the system will automatically detect and set the cycle. I recommend going into the app and turning on the "AI usage habit recommendation" and "parameter memory" options. The system will then save your frequently used custom settings so you can quickly select them next time. I've also organized the other common modes for you, such as Quick Wash, Heavy Duty, Gentle, and Bulky. For high-temp sterilization or garment care needs, Xiaomi offers Air Wash, Fragrance Wash, High-Temp Wash, and Sterilization Wash. In this mode, the system starts the cycle by activating 90 ° C high-temperature steam , which, according to the official specs , achieves 99.99%sterilization and 99.99 %virus removal, along with odor elimination. After the high-temperature steam phase, it proceeds with a wash using hot water. . If you have children, pets, or sensitive skin, the Sterilization Wash is a great choice. The Fragrance Wash is also quite interesting, perfect for when your clothes smell like hot pot. The system uses low-temperature steam and adds a small amount of detergent to refresh the fabric. Xiaomi's custom features are very rich; for example, when you select Sterilization Wash in the app. You can further customize the soak time, and the water temperature can be set to 40, 60, or a maximum of 80 degrees. Another feature I really like is that this Xiaomi model supports an anti-wrinkle and freshness mode. Beyond that, Xiaomi covers various common special needs, such as baby clothes, lingerie, new clothes, curtains , large items, sportswear, and performance gear.

Keep the load small—about one t-shirt, one pair of pants, and a pair of socks, roughly one to two kilograms—and the system will finish in 12 minutes. Now, let’s test the feature everyone cares about most: the drying function. As mentioned earlier, judging by Xiaomi's pricing, it's clear the Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is one of the most mainstream and relatively affordable water-cooled drying models available. Taking the machine apart, we can see the. Mijia Smart Washing Machine Pro is indeed a standard water-cooled dryer. Xiaomi uses a stainless steel exhaust pipe to prevent bacterial growth and minimize lint buildup. The principle behind water-cooled drying is actually quite easy to understand. We’ve shared an animation about it before, so let’s review it here. Water-cooled drying works by first heating the air with a module at the top of the machine, then blowing it into the drum. This raises the internal temperature,. turning the moisture in the clothes into steam and gradually removing it. This is where the magic happens. By injecting cold water to keep the cooling module at a low temperature, the high-temperature steam condenses back into water. Then, we take the opportunity to drain this condensed water away through the pipes. This allows us to gradually dry the clothes; the principle is very simple. I think you’ve all seen it now. So, overall, the biggest feature of the condenser drying method is its relatively simple principle and. straightforward structure, which is the main reason why every brand can produce a popular washer-dryer combo. However, it must be clarified that the drying temperature during the condenser process is relatively high. Using it for regular quilts, bedsheets, clothes, T-shirts, and pants is generally not a problem. Just be mindful of T-shirts with prints ; it’s recommended to turn them inside out or use a laundry bag, and unfold them immediately after drying. The most important point is to follow the laundry label instructions; never force-dry items, as it may lead to shrinkage or fiber damage.

starting every cycle. The door will then lock automatically to prevent children or pets from getting inside. it. That's right, Vivo has hidden a multi-zone laser autofocus sensor with 1536 ranging points to the left of the lens module. With so many fun and useful shooting modes, it’s easy to see why camera enthusiasts love Vivo; it’s highly versatile.
